//: The site's own modules, as TypeScript. archive/TRANSITION.md Stage 13.
Output goes to aab/ at the exact path each module is served
from, because those paths are named in HTML, in sw.js and in
vite.config.ts's list of runtime externals: a hashed chunk
would fight all three. So no bundling and no renaming, one
file in and one file out, which is what tsc alone does.
A module here imports its neighbours by the path the browser
fetches them from, /activation.js and not ../activation.js,
because that is what ends up in the emitted file. paths below
is the compile-time claim about each such path.
Every entry points at a SOURCE, and types/ is gone with the
last two that did not: /saved.js is ./saved.ts, so a module
importing it by its served path gets the real types rather
than a description of them, and the two cannot drift because
there is only one. A module still written as JavaScript needs
a hand-written declaration to be named here, and the answer
to that is to convert the module. /content.js is the one
entry reaching outside this directory: its source is
shared/content.ts, and a ladder's is shared/curricula/<school>.ts,
both of which scripts/build-modules.ts compiles into aab/.
pieces.ts is the first module here to import one, and it is
why the three lines below are set the way they are. rootDir
is the REPO ROOT, because tsc refuses an input above rootDir
and shared/content.ts is one; that puts every output under
aab/src/ inside outDir, which scripts/build-modules.ts knows
and is the only thing that reads this compile's output.
allowImportingTsExtensions is because content.ts names its
four ladders by their real filenames, and
rewriteRelativeImportExtensions is what makes that legal in a
config that EMITS rather than one that only reads.
declaration: true is the point of the exercise. app/src/types/
holds hand-written .d.ts files describing these modules, and
Stage 13 is done when that directory is empty because the
modules describe themselves.
//exclude: Empty on purpose. tsc excludes outDir and declarationDir by
default, and both of those contain this directory, so the
default leaves nothing to compile and says so with TS18003.
